source_policy: Research papers, author manuscripts and original publisher/archive records only; no secondary summaries used as scientific evidence.

sources.title: Lieb-Robinson Bounds and the Exponential Clustering Theorem
sources.supports: Finite-velocity approximate locality for bounded short-range interactions on a metric graph; not emergent Lorentz symmetry or dimension selection.
sources.inspection: Abstract and full-text HTML including setup and interaction assumptions. The CP12 unbounded onsite extension is argued separately by an onsite interaction picture.

sources.authors: Matthew B. Hastings and Tohru Koma
sources.title: Spectral Gap and Exponential Decay of Correlations
sources.supports: Short-range spin/fermion systems admit appropriate propagation/clustering bounds; no claim that every gapped CP12 state has spatial geometry.

sources.title: General relativity as an effective field theory: The leading quantum corrections
sources.supports: Controlled low-energy gravitational EFT and separation of ultraviolet matching data from infrared nonanalytic effects; no microscopic GRUT derivation.
sources.inspection: Author abstract and publication metadata; repository WORKING_FOUNDATION contains the previously worked comparison.

sources.title: Vacuum quantum fluctuations in curved space and the theory of gravitation
sources.original_citation: Dokl. Akad. Nauk SSSR 177:1 (1967), 70-71; English translation Sov. Phys. Dokl. 12 (1968), 1040-1041
sources.supports: Historical induced-gravity proposal, where quantum fluctuations generate curvature contributions once a geometric description is supplied.
sources.inspection: Original journal archive record; detailed heat-kernel formula in synthesis is independently stated and checked against S5.

sources.title: Heat kernel expansion: user's manual
sources.supports: Covariant heat-kernel coefficients and one-loop effective actions; these require a geometric differential operator and do not derive one from CP12.
sources.inspection: Author manuscript record; standard scalar a1 coefficient used as a declared conditional matching calculation.

sources.title: The lattice Schwinger model as a discrete sum of filled Wilson loops
sources.supports: Established fermion hopping expansion into gauge loops; not CP12 coefficients, Hamiltonian or spatial selection.

sources.title: Entanglement Equilibrium and the Einstein Equation
sources.supports: Conditional relation between stationary small-ball generalized entropy and first-order Einstein equations; additional caveat for nonconformal matter.
sources.inspection: Author abstract and version notes; repository WORKING_FOUNDATION independently develops the displayed small-ball coefficients.

sources.title: Photons and Gravitons in S-Matrix Theory: Derivation of Charge Conservation and Equality of Gravitational and Inertial Mass
sources.supports: Universality of massless spin-two coupling under Lorentz-invariant S-matrix and pole assumptions; not the existence of the CP12 graviton.
sources.inspection: Publisher abstract; subscription full text was not read. Relevant benchmark already present in CP12 gravity-response packet.

sources.title: Limits on massless particles
sources.supports: Massless spin greater than one obstruction under the specified conserved Lorentz-covariant stress-tensor premises and the known gauge-gravity qualifications.
sources.inspection: Original four-page paper, including Theorem 2 and its qualifications.

sources.title: On the dynamics of lattice systems with unbounded on-site terms in the Hamiltonian
sources.supports: A dimension-independent Lieb-Robinson bound in the presence of arbitrary self-adjoint onsite terms and bounded sufficiently local interactions; direct relevance to CP12 compact rotors in a fixed graph block.
sources.inspection: Original fourteen-page author manuscript, especially Theorem 3.1 and the strong-topology interaction-picture setup.
